metadata.subject: [Policy] Company car policy - updated policy v3.0

body:
Dear colleagues,

Following approval by the Management Committee, please note the updated company car policy policy (v3.0), effective 2025-01-01.

New lease contracts are limited to fully electric vehicles with a list price up to EUR 55,000. Existing lease contracts continue until their contractual end date.

The full policy is available on the HR SharePoint (HR Policies > Current Policies). This replaces all previous versions.

Kind regards,
Wim Goossens
Head of HR
Vandenberg Logistics NV
